semantics.definition: How wide the room a character takes up is, side to side, standing with its arms down: its size along x in the world. Measured on the three standing (23 Nov): 0.68 m for Clay, 0.70 m for the Mannequin, 0.83 m for the Fairy Bot, hands included. A guess, not agreed.
semantics.responsibility: Give a character the ground it stands on.
